head: ChatGPT Standard and Advanced Voice end on 11 December; Live replaces them
dek: OpenAI is retiring ChatGPT's Standard and Advanced voice modes on 11 December. Anyone using either moves to Live, the voice mode OpenAI introduced in July.
details: Live can listen while it speaks, so you can add a detail in the middle of an answer, and it can hand a web search to another model while the conversation goes on. Your old voice conversations stay in your history. Using the camera or sharing your screen in a voice chat still runs on the older Advanced system for now.
means: If you talk to ChatGPT, the voice will behave differently: you can interrupt it, and it may answer while you pause.
todo: Try Live now in the ChatGPT app so the switch isn't a surprise; nothing else to do.
